title: Brian Curry: Mentalist and Magician Live at The Capital Hilton
includes: Magic Show for Adults: Brian Curry the Good Liar
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Expect a fast-paced, 65-minute performance packed with mind reading, impossible predictions, and quick-witted comedy. From the moment Brian Curry takes the stage, the crowd becomes part of the show—whether he’s calling out your thoughts, toying with your instincts, or turning a skeptical guest into the star of the night. The setting is intimate, the laughs are constant, and the surprises just keep coming. It’s not just a magic show—it’s a mental rollercoaster that leaves you wondering what’s real.
